caption:
Stop guessing portions with measuring cups

Measuring cups show volume, not weight, so a cup of rice, oats, or peanut butter can weigh something different every time. That makes it hard to match a recipe written in grams or keep meal-prep portions consistent from one bowl to the next.

This digital scale measures in both grams and ounces, holds up to eleven pounds, and has a tare function to zero out a bowl or plate before you add food. It's rated 4.6 stars from about 178,000 reviews.

For about $10, portions and recipe measurements come out the same every time instead of a guess.
